| [CLAIM-395](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-395.md) | Under Montévil and Mossio's definition of closure, a closed set of constraints has at least two members, and if each constraint is produced at the time scale of a constraint in the set that generates it and not at the scale at which it is itself conserved, the set includes at least one slow and one fast dependence, so a system with a single constraint of its own cannot realise closure |  | Active |

| [CLAIM-400](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-400.md) v6 | In the meaning–authority model linearized at symmetry, a third, maintained legibility state that authority moves (ε) and that moves interpretation (ν) or conferral (μ), with persistence λ < 1 and nonnegative couplings, destabilizes the symmetric state exactly when the two-variable condition holds with β + νε/(1 − λ) in place of β and δ + με/(1 − λ) in place of δ: at the threshold the regime is indistinguishable from stronger two-variable couplings, and the slower it is the more it adds, while away from the threshold it adds a mode that no two-variable model has, so a lean in the regime can outlast the advantages it was built from | [QUESTION-253](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-253.md) asked whether authority's effect on what becomes legible as evidence is a third channel with its own instability condition, or [CLAIM-340](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-340.md)'s κ′ renamed. | [CLAIM-478](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-478.md) v6 | Rate differences help make structure and not only mark it: where some degrees of freedom settle faster than others by more than the rates vary among them, the relation they settle into is a constraint on the system over the window between the two rates, so what is a realization at one rate works as a constraint at another; and organization can make new rate differences in turn, as when modes slow near an instability and become order parameters, so hierarchies of rates and constraints can produce one another | The owner's, U12 of the exchange of 2026-10-27: "I think we may still have a coverage gap wrt scale separation and how that participates in creating structure". | [CLAIM-480](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-480.md) v2 | Composing interactions can turn an interior into a constraint, and sometimes into a constraint of a new kind: in the chain E = ½k₁(x₁ − x₂)² + ½k₂(x₂ − x₃)², with x₂ internal and equilibrated, the boundary sees E_eff = ½·k₁k₂/(k₁ + k₂)·(x₁ − x₃)², a coupling between x₁ and x₃ that neither part has; if the interior relaxes slowly, eliminating it leaves a history-dependent constraint, a memory kernel, so interconnection fixes an effective constraint on the boundary's trajectories and separation of time scales decides only whether that constraint is approximately memoryless; and for cellular sheaves the reduced constraint can relate three boundary values where every relation among the parts is pairwise | From A22 §4 and A23 §IV of the exchange of 2026-10-27, which called composition "the most important missing mechanism" after the owner's U20. | [CLAIM-597](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-597.md) v5 | Where every replacement part is supplied from outside, an organization can become independent of what founded it but never of what feeds it: with damage at rate d and supplied repair at rate ρs the intact fraction holds at ρs/(ρs + d), needs a supply growing as θ/(1 − θ) times the damage rate to hold a share θ, and decays as e^(−dt) once the supply stops, as DNA origami that self-heals from a strand pool and origami that replicates from supplied monomers both illustrate | The assistant's, on the owner's invitation of 2026-11-05 to add readings and claims to the DNA origami filing. | [CLAIM-600](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-600.md) v10 | Transient support can be withdrawn safely only if it started a process that keeps itself going on a flux that will stay available, was large enough to carry the supported party past any threshold that process has, outlasted the threat it stood in for, and left the work to the party throughout, in each subtask it must later do alone and not only in its role as a whole, at no more effort than it could bear, and, where the capacity is cumulative and its field moves fast, kept up after withdrawal; inputs the party cannot produce must stay supplied as a standing part of the arrangement; support that fails these leaves dependence or decay, but meeting them all is not enough, since support can carry a function nobody names before withdrawal; and persistence after withdrawal is needed to tell which, though slow reversion can mimic it | The assistant's, at the owner's request of 2026-11-05 to characterize "what differentiates transient support that induces dependency and is hazardous to remove from transient support that builds new capabilities and is safe to remove", with reintroduction and ecological recovery proposed as cases. It draws together the branch's three domains: DNA origami, aid and development, and ecology. Three conditions are needed for it. First, the support starts a self-sustaining process on an ambient flux instead of doing the upkeep. Planted tree islands, weeded for 2.5 years, kept their advantage to 16–18 years because established trees keep drawing seed dispersers (Holl et al.; Schubert et al.). Supplied repair, by contrast, never becomes optional ([CLAIM-597](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-597.md)). Second, the threat it stood in for is gone. Conservation-reliant species stay reliant while fire is suppressed or habitat threats persist (Mussmann et al.; Brown et al.). Third, the party did the work throughout. Support that does the work wears capacity down by disuse ([CLAIM-558](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-558.md)), by slack effort (Ostrom et al.) or by selection for the supported conditions, which costs hatchery steelhead fitness in the wild within one generation (Christie et al.). Captive-bred translocated stock shows negative population growth (Morris et al.). Persistence must be shown after withdrawal: impact at exit and judged success both overstate it. Revised the same day after two counterpoints the owner asked for. So that route is confined to help that is assured and permanent. A household asset threshold (Balboni et al.) adds a condition on size: support too small decays with no dependence at all. Urban development adds three cautions. Some public inputs are a standing part of a coproduced service (Evans; Watson). Forty years of persistence can be slow reversion (Kline and Moretti). And a place can last while the people it served are dispersed (Collins and Shester; LaVoice). The wording is the assistant's (Claude, in this session); adopting it is the owner's call. Moved into the SYNTHESIS scheme on 2026-11-07 ([ADR-077](../../../record/decisions.d/ADR-077.md)) and returned to CLAIM on 2026-11-08 (ADR-084), keeping the standing the status review of 2026-11-06 gave it under the rulings the owner delegated. | Active |
| [CLAIM-602](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-602.md) v5 | Where an organization's capacity is learned by doing the work it serves, and decays with disuse, outside supply that does the work first lowers the capacity kept, and the longer it does all of it the longer recovery takes once it stops, while supply that covers only what the organization cannot yet do leaves its learning untouched, so what decides dependence is the order in which supply and capacity are used, not the amount of supply | The assistant's, at the owner's request of 2026-11-05 to look to aid and development for theory on how aid-dependent organizations become self-sufficient. After full substitution for 10, 20 and 40 time units, meeting demand takes 3.8, 6.4 and 11.4 units once aid stops, because the work an organization can do is capped by its capacity, so it regrows from a seed. | [CLAIM-603](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-603.md) v7 | A capability lost because another reliably supplies it is the Black Queen's loss, favoured to the one who loses it, and whether it is dependency or division of labour is decided by the supply, not the loss: one-way supply set from outside, as aid is, leaves a dependence that nothing in the dependent's dynamics limits and that withdrawal punishes, while reciprocal loss, each partner supplying what the other gave up, leaves interdependence, so the aim framed as self-sufficiency is better framed as reciprocity | The assistant's, on the owner's remark of 2026-11-05 that "assured help makes recipients lose skill" sounds "closely related to niche differentiation and specialization phenomena". The record holds the biology. On the Black Queen Hypothesis ([THEORY-1048](../../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1048.md)) a cell that stops making a leaky public good saves its cost while others still supply it, so the loss is favoured to the individual and spreads. Buchnera ([THEORY-1103](../../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1103.md)) has lost the genes its host covers and kept those its host lacks. The Samaritan's dilemma has the same logic (Ostrom et al.), and Azam, Devarajan and O'Connell's recipient is better off in the high-aid state. The loss itself is not the pathology. What differs is the supply. A Black Queen loss stops by itself when helpers grow rare, because the helpers are the same population. The wording is the assistant's (Claude, in this session); adopting it is the owner's call. | Proposed |
| [CLAIM-604](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-604.md) v3 | Where each damaged part of a structure is repaired by drawing on a flux at a rate proportional to the structure's intact share, as a flame's upkeep is, it has an ignition threshold below which it goes out with the supply still on, a supply level below which it collapses rather than declines, and an outage after which restoring the supply does not relight it; repair supplied at a rate set by the supply alone, whatever the structure's state, has none of the three | The assistant's, at the owner's request of 2026-11-05 to connect [CLAIM-597](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-597.md)'s supplied maintenance to the record's dissipative structures. | [CLAIM-605](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-605.md) v5 | Where capacity is learned by doing, decays with disuse and needs capacity already present to grow, support that does the work has a deadline after which withdrawal no longer restores capacity, and a slow taper of such support is worse than an abrupt cut because it holds practice down long enough to cross the threshold; support that covers only what the party cannot yet do needs no taper but cannot lift a party already below the threshold | The assistant's, filling gaps the supplied-maintenance filing left, at the owner's request of 2026-11-05 to "proceed systematically filling all of those identified gaps". [CLAIM-602](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-602.md) modelled crowding out with no threshold, so capacity always regrew from a seed. Its own limits named the threshold case, Azam et al.'s trap. Here learning by doing needs capacity already present, dC/dt = λPC(1 − C) − μC. With λ = 1, μ = 0.3 and τ = 1.5, a party alone keeps C = 0.7, and C below 0.276 decays to nothing. The model gives three results. Support that does all the work has a deadline: after ln(0.7/0.276)/0.3 = 3.10 time units capacity has crossed the threshold, and withdrawal no longer restores it.   supply. They come in a family set by their initial data, and they keep

  Their shape is "predetermined by the equation parameters, rather than

- Topological solitons carry a charge that continuous change cannot
  remove.
